description.narrative: Establishment of child protection mechanisms - formal as well as informal - in cooperation with authorities and civil society organisations respectively. The program is implemented in Basra and Suleymaniah.
Etablering av skyddsmekanismer för barn - både formella sådana i samarbete med lokala myndigheter och informella i samarbete med civilsamhällesorganisationer - i Basra respektive Suleymaniah.

General question: Results related to the intended outcome 2015Question: Summarise results related to the intended outcome (this information will be sent to Open Aid)Answer: Despite security problems which required adjustment of field work, training sessions and consultations on contributions to National Child Protection Policy were delivered and included in a policy draft, awaiting endorsement by the Government.
Work on child protection units experienced more disturbances due to security problems. In one governorate, work proceeded far with trainings and establishment of committees although there are unclarities about monitoring and sustainability. In the other governorate, SC had to close down the local office and thus had to terminate activities. Awareness raising and training activities were carried out but the local organization was not possible to set up.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
